_comment: Every fact on the landing page that could be wrong lives here, and tests/test_landing_facts.py checks each one against the corpus, the eval set and the exam configs. v1 typed these by hand into a template and two of its four hero citations pointed at the wrong syllabus section (PHY C2 is thermal expansion, not motion; CHM A4 is the periodic table, not the mole) on a page whose whole promise is that citations are real.

deck.subject: Core Mathematics
deck.question: Solve 2x² + 5x − 3 = 0 by completing the square.
steps: Add the square of half the coefficient of x, (1.25)² = 1.5625, to both sides.

source.label: WAEC syllabus
source.title: Quadratic equations and their graphs
source.cited: Solve quadratic equations by factorisation, by completing the square and by formula.
source.after: Form a quadratic equation from given roots. Use the sum and product of roots.

deck.subject: Physics
deck.question: A car starts from rest and reaches 20 m/s in 8 s. Find its acceleration and the distance covered.

source.label: WAEC syllabus
source.title: Linear motion
source.before: Distinguish distance from displacement and speed from velocity. Define acceleration.
source.cited: Use the equations of uniformly accelerated motion to solve problems, including free fall under gravity.

deck.subject: Chemistry
deck.question: How many moles are there in 8 g of oxygen gas, O₂?
steps: Number of moles = mass ÷ molar mass.

source.label: WAEC syllabus
source.title: The mole concept and stoichiometry
source.before: Define the mole, the Avogadro constant and molar mass.
source.cited: Convert between mass, moles, number of particles and volume of gas at s.t.p.

deck.subject: Core Mathematics
deck.question: Differentiate y = sin x.
deck.refusal: This is not on the WAEC Core Mathematics syllabus, so I do not have material for it. It belongs to Further Mathematics, which is a separate subject and a separate paper.

source.label: WAEC syllabus · not on this syllabus
source.title: Differentiation of algebraic functions

source.cited: You will not be asked to differentiate sin x, cos x or tan x on this paper.
